description: revise an existing Work Manifest document via a full-document rewrite. Use only when a narrow state-recording process is not sufficient.
embedding_description: Revise an existing Work Manifest document by replacing its current manifest content with updated phase-level information. Use to update ordered phases, phase outcomes, status, authorization state, or other manifest-only planning context after progress, review, or replanning. Keep the manifest at the phase level only; do not add work items, steps, or sub-steps.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Writing Work Manifest content to the knowledge base. patch_work_manifest accepts {manifest_id, content}. The manifest should contain phases only — no work items, steps, or sub-steps.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValidationError: arguments do not conform to the schema. StorageError: knowledge base write failed.
